observations.tube: All three tube inputs are visibly crowded, near-parallel cylinders with broad coincident attachment neighborhoods. Each source/result pair is geometrically identical because the fixed-attachment preflight refuses before occupancy; four red blocker rows remain visible and the labels do not imply a solve.
observations.taperedBelly: The exact Bytebound profile materially restores belly morphology and visibly narrows the attachment ends while preserving the same centerline positions. It removes two of four tube blockers, but every source/result pair remains geometrically identical because two insertion collisions survive. The lower red attachment cloud and the overlapping cyan/purple insertion neighborhood make the refusal visually plausible.
observations.crowdingResponse: Baseline, mild, and moderate remain distinguishable by increasing interior crowding. Neither profile produces a packed state, so no visual separation or anatomical improvement is claimed.
observations.labelIntegrity: Every frame names source profile, solver disposition, and selected state. No frame uses the ambiguous labels 'Before packing' or 'Packing result'.

verdict.failureCertificate: The exact tapered belly is directionally useful but insufficient: M34/M45 and M12/M45 retain insertion penetrations of about 0.20 and 0.105 across all three pressure rungs, preventing any lawful occupancy update.
